spec.description: Subscribe to Jetstream: every repository commit, identity change and account status change on the network as JSON, filtered by collection and by account, from now or from a past cursor. One WebSocket connection per subscription; the parameters travel in the connection URL and the server starts pushing as soon as it is open.

parameters.title: SubscribeParameters
parameters.description: The filter and the starting point, sent as the connection URL's query string.

wantedCollections.description: Collection NSIDs to include, such as `app.bsky.feed.post`; a trailing `.*` matches a prefix (`app.bsky.graph.*`). At most 100. Omit for every collection. Sent as repeated `wantedCollections` query parameters.

wantedDids.description: DIDs to include, at most 10000. Omit for every account. Sent as repeated `wantedDids` query parameters.

cursor.description: Replay from this instant, as Unix microseconds on the wire; omit to start from now. Jetstream keeps a bounded backlog, and a cursor before it starts from the oldest event kept.

payload.title: JetstreamEvent
payload.description: One event. `kind` says which of `commit`, `identity` and `account` is present.

did.description: DID of the repository the event is about.

time_us.description: When the event was emitted, as Unix microseconds on the wire. Also the cursor to resume from.

kind.description: Event kind: a repository commit, an identity (handle or DID document) change, or an account status change.

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: One record operation in the repository; present when `kind` is `commit`.

collection.description: Collection NSID of the record, such as `app.bsky.feed.post`.

record.description: The record, for `create` and `update`; absent on `delete`. Any collection's record, so kept as a map: `$type` names the lexicon.

cid.description: CID of the record, for `create` and `update`; absent on `delete`.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: An identity change; present when `kind` is `identity`.

handle.description: The current handle, when it resolved.

seq.description: Sequence number on the upstream firehose.

account.title: AccountStatus
account.description: An account status change; present when `kind` is `account`.

active.description: Whether the account is active on its host.

seq.description: Sequence number on the upstream firehose.

status.description: Why the account is inactive, when it is: `takendown`, `suspended`, `deleted` or `deactivated`.

unverified.detail: No recording yet: the sandbox this spec was written in cannot reach bsky.network. The `record.yml` workflow reads Jetstream for ten seconds through the generated client (`test/record_jetstream.py`) and writes the messages beside `examples/*.parameters.json`.

notes: Written from the Jetstream README as remembered, not read: the docs host was unreachable. The first recording confirms or corrects it. `compress`, `requireHello` and `maxMessageSizeBytes` are not declared.

There is no subscribe frame: the parameters are the connection URL's query string and the server pushes from the moment the socket opens, which is what `push: connect` declares. No `envelope.verb` is declared because no frame states a verb; the `ws-verb` warning from `truewire check` is expected, and the mock serves the endpoint through `push` instead.
`status` on an account event is a bare string: the lexicon lists its values as known values, not a closed set, so no enum is declared.
